Used by screen readers to explain to users which item they are currently focused on, and how many items there are total in a group. For example, given a list with 15 items. trans-unit.source: Privacy features give you greater control over the types of content you see, helping you stay safe online.

trans-unit.source: If you activate these features, they’ll overwrite any custom DNS you’re using. These protections are not a substitute for taking other security precautions — for example, while blocking malware you should still avoid downloading attachments in strange emails.
